name: Item Randomizer
author: S.A.M Framework
description: Every item in the game joins the common loot pool on every floor: artifacts, orbs, keys, class gear, the lot, on the ground, in chests and in shops, and class and race spellbooks wherever an item is rolled during play (shops, creatures' pockets, summoned chests). A S.A.M version of the community mod of the same name: it changes the loot rules instead of replacing items.json, so it composes with every mod that adds items, and the deep stores keep selling instead of falling back to rocks. A Lite toggle in the settings keeps artifacts and orbs out of shops.
